description: This file defines interfaces related to serialization codecs in the Orleans framework, particularly focusing on base codecs, generalized base codecs, and specializable base codecs. It specifies methods for serialization, deserialization, and type support determination, serving as part of the serialization subsystem.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T into the provided buffer writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader into the provided value.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines whether a given type is supported by the codec.

methods.name: GetSpecializedCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec implementation specialized for the specified type.
